== Biography ==
William was born in 1824. He was the son of [[Glasgow-193|James Glasgow]] and [[McNeil-3468|Mary McNeil]]. He passed away in 1909.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-193]] is assessed at 83% (probable). William Allen’s retained biography names James Glasgow and Mary McNeil as his parents. His exact 1824 birth fits the same couple whose son Robert Anderson is explicitly identified in the county biographical sketch; that sibling-family context supports the inherited placement beyond chronology alone.

Probable 83%; Robert’s parent clause corroborates the family, but does not by itself prove William as another son.

Next useful test: Read William’s own Faris entry or obituary for the same parents.
